local Parser = require("parser")
local G = {}
G.__index = G
G.binary = { ["+"] = "ADD", ["-"] = "SUB", ["*"] = "MUL", ["/"] = "DIV", ["%"] = "MOD",
    ["<"] = "LT", ["<="] = "LE", [">"] = "GT", [">="] = "GE", ["=="] = "EQ", ["!="] = "NE" }
G.jumps = { JUMP = true, JUMPF = true, JUMPT = true }
G.conditional = { JUMPF = true, JUMPT = true }
G.transfers = { JUMP = true, RET = true, RETV = true, HALT = true }
G.negated = { LT = "GE", LE = "GT", GT = "LE", GE = "LT", EQ = "NE", NE = "EQ" }
G.inverse = { JUMPF = "JUMPT", JUMPT = "JUMPF" }
function G.instruction(op, args, position) return { op = op, args = args or {}, position = position } end
function G.new() return setmetatable({ code = {}, loops = {} }, G) end
function G:emit(op, position, ...) self.code[#self.code + 1] = G.instruction(op, { ... }, position) end
function G:mark(label) label.position = #self.code + 1 end
function G:finish()
    local result = {}
    for i, instruction in ipairs(self.code) do
        local args = G.jumps[instruction.op] and { assert(instruction.args[1].position) } or instruction.args
        result[i] = G.instruction(instruction.op, args, instruction.position)
    end
    return result
end
function G:expression(node)
    local kind, position = node.kind, node.position
    if kind == "integer" then self:emit("PUSH", position, node.value)
    elseif kind == "boolean" then self:emit("PUSH", position, node.value and 1 or 0)
    elseif kind == "variable" then
        local ref = node.referent
        if ref.kind == "global" then self:emit("LOADG", position, ref.address)
        else self:emit("LOADL", position, ref.slot) end
    elseif kind == "array" then
        self:expression(node.index)
        self:emit("LOADA", position, node.referent.address, node.referent.size)
    elseif kind == "read" then self:emit("READ", position)
    elseif kind == "call" then
        for _, argument in ipairs(node.arguments) do self:expression(argument) end
        self:emit("CALL", position, node.referent.name, #node.arguments)
    elseif kind == "unary" then
        self:expression(node.operand)
        self:emit(node.operator == "-" and "NEG" or "NOT", position)
    elseif node.operator == "&&" or node.operator == "||" then
        local shortcut, ending = {}, {}
        self:expression(node.left)
        self:emit(node.operator == "&&" and "JUMPF" or "JUMPT", position, shortcut)
        self:expression(node.right)
        self:emit("JUMP", position, ending)
        self:mark(shortcut)
        self:emit("PUSH", position, node.operator == "||" and 1 or 0)
        self:mark(ending)
    else
        self:expression(node.left)
        self:expression(node.right)
        self:emit(G.binary[node.operator], position)
    end
end
function G:statement(node)
    local kind, position = node.kind, node.position
    if kind == "declaration" then
        if node.initializer then self:expression(node.initializer) else self:emit("PUSH", node.name_position, 0) end
        self:emit("STOREL", node.name_position, node.slot)
    elseif kind == "assignment" then
        if node.index then self:expression(node.index) end
        self:expression(node.value)
        local ref = node.referent
        if node.index then self:emit("STOREA", position, ref.address, ref.size)
        elseif ref.kind == "global" then self:emit("STOREG", position, ref.address)
        else self:emit("STOREL", position, ref.slot) end
    elseif kind == "call_statement" then
        self:expression(node.expression)
        if node.expression.type ~= "void" then self:emit("POP", position) end
    elseif kind == "print" then
        for _, argument in ipairs(node.arguments) do self:expression(argument) end
        self:emit("PRINT", position, #node.arguments)
    elseif kind == "if" then
        local alternative, ending = {}, {}
        self:expression(node.condition)
        self:emit("JUMPF", position, alternative)
        self:statement(node.consequent)
        if not node.otherwise then self:mark(alternative)
        else
            self:emit("JUMP", position, ending)
            self:mark(alternative)
            self:statement(node.otherwise)
            self:mark(ending)
        end
    elseif kind == "while" then
        local start, ending = {}, {}
        self:mark(start)
        self:expression(node.condition)
        self:emit("JUMPF", position, ending)
        self.loops[#self.loops + 1] = { ending, start }
        self:statement(node.body)
        table.remove(self.loops)
        self:emit("JUMP", position, start)
        self:mark(ending)
    elseif kind == "for" then
        local start, update, ending = {}, {}, {}
        if node.initial then self:statement(node.initial) end
        self:mark(start)
        if node.condition then self:expression(node.condition); self:emit("JUMPF", position, ending) end
        self.loops[#self.loops + 1] = { ending, update }
        self:statement(node.body)
        table.remove(self.loops)
        self:mark(update)
        if node.update then self:statement(node.update) end
        self:emit("JUMP", position, start)
        self:mark(ending)
    elseif kind == "break" or kind == "continue" then
        self:emit("JUMP", position, self.loops[#self.loops][kind == "continue" and 2 or 1])
    elseif kind == "return" then
        if node.value then self:expression(node.value); self:emit("RETV", position) else self:emit("RET", position) end
    elseif kind == "block" then for _, child in ipairs(node.statements) do self:statement(child) end end
end
local function assign_slots(fn)
    local declarations = {}
    local function visit(node)
        if node.kind == "declaration" then declarations[#declarations + 1] = node end
        for _, child in ipairs(Parser.statement_children(node)) do visit(child) end
    end
    visit(fn.body)
    table.sort(declarations, function(a, b)
        return a.name_position[1] < b.name_position[1]
            or (a.name_position[1] == b.name_position[1] and a.name_position[2] < b.name_position[2])
    end)
    local slots = { table.unpack(fn.parameters) }
    for _, declaration in ipairs(declarations) do slots[#slots + 1] = declaration end
    for i, declaration in ipairs(slots) do declaration.slot = i - 1 end
    return slots
end
function G.generate(globals, functions, main)
    local address, initialization = 0, G.new()
    for _, variable in ipairs(globals) do
        variable.address = address
        address = address + (variable.size or 1)
    end
    for _, variable in ipairs(globals) do
        if variable.initializer then
            initialization:expression(variable.initializer)
            initialization:emit("STOREG", variable.name_position, variable.address)
        end
    end
    initialization:emit("CALL", main.name_position, "main", 0)
    initialization:emit("HALT", main.name_position)
    local units = { { name = "<init>", slots = {}, before = initialization:finish() } }
    for _, fn in ipairs(functions) do
        local slots, generator = assign_slots(fn), G.new()
        generator:emit("ENTER", fn.name_position, #slots)
        generator:statement(fn.body)
        if fn.type == "void" then generator:emit("RET", fn.body.end_position) end
        units[#units + 1] = { name = fn.name, fn = fn, slots = slots, before = generator:finish() }
    end
    return units, address
end
return G

local M = {}
local keywords, pairs_set = {}, {}
for word in ("int bool void true false if else while for break continue return print read"):gmatch("%S+") do keywords[word] = true end
for word in ("<= >= == != && ||"):gmatch("%S+") do pairs_set[word] = true end
function M.fail(kind, position, message)
    error({ category = "compile", kind = kind, position = position, message = message }, 0)
end
function M.tokenize(lines)
    local parts = {}
    for _, record in ipairs(lines) do parts[#parts + 1] = record[2] end
    local source = table.concat(parts, "\n") .. "\n"
    local tokens, index, line, column = {}, 1, lines[1][1], 1
    while index <= #source do
        local ch, start, position = source:sub(index, index), index, { line, column }
        local pair = source:sub(index, index + 1)
        local kind, spelling
        if ch == " " or ch == "\n" then index = index + 1
        elseif pair == "//" then index = assert(source:find("\n", index, true))
        elseif pair == "/*" then
            local close = source:find("*/", index + 2, true)
            if not close then M.fail("lexical", position, "unterminated comment") end
            index = close + 2
        elseif ch:match("[A-Za-z_]") then
            spelling = source:sub(index):match("^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*")
            kind, index = keywords[spelling] and "keyword" or "identifier", index + #spelling
        elseif ch:match("[0-9]") then
            spelling = source:sub(index):match("^[0-9]+")
            local digits = spelling:gsub("^0+", "")
            if #digits > 10 or (#digits == 10 and digits > "2147483647") then
                M.fail("lexical", position, "integer literal too large")
            end
            kind, index = "integer", index + #spelling
        elseif pairs_set[pair] then kind, spelling, index = "symbol", pair, index + 2
        elseif ("+-*/%<>=!(){}[],;"):find(ch, 1, true) then kind, spelling, index = "symbol", ch, index + 1
        else M.fail("lexical", position, "unexpected character '" .. ch .. "'") end
        if kind then tokens[#tokens + 1] = { kind = kind, spelling = spelling, position = position } end
        local consumed, last, count = source:sub(start, index - 1), false, 0
        for at in consumed:gmatch("()\n") do last, count = at, count + 1 end
        if count > 0 then line, column = line + count, #consumed - last + 1
        else column = column + #consumed end
    end
    local last = lines[#lines]
    tokens[#tokens + 1] = { kind = "end", spelling = "", position = { last[1], #last[2] + 1 } }
    return tokens
end
return M

local lexer = require("lexer")
local Parser = require("parser")
local Analyzer = require("semantic")
local G = require("codegen")
local VM = require("vm")
local rules = { "const-jump", "not-compare", "not-jump", "invert-branch", "thread", "jump-next", "unreachable" }
local reports = { ["listing.txt"] = {}, ["output.txt"] = {}, ["diagnostics.txt"] = {}, ["stats.txt"] = {} }
local function append(target, source)
    for _, line in ipairs(source) do target[#target + 1] = line end
end
local function position_less(a, b) return a[1] < b[1] or (a[1] == b[1] and a[2] < b[2]) end
local function position_text(p) return p[1] .. ":" .. p[2] end
local function sum(values)
    local total = 0
    for _, value in ipairs(values) do total = total + value end
    return total
end
local function warnings(analysis)
    local result = {}
    for _, variable in ipairs(analysis.variables) do
        if variable.read_accesses == 0 then
            local role = variable.kind == "parameter" and "parameter" or "variable"
            result[#result + 1] = { variable.name_position, "unused " .. role .. " '" .. variable.name .. "'" }
        end
    end
    local function visit(node)
        if node.kind == "block" then
            for i = 1, #node.statements - 1 do
                if not Analyzer.can_complete(node.statements[i]) then
                    result[#result + 1] = { node.statements[i + 1].position, "unreachable statement" }
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(Parser.statement_children(node)) do visit(child) end
    end
    for _, fn in ipairs(analysis.functions) do visit(fn.body) end
    local reachable, pending = {}, { analysis.globals.main }
    while #pending > 0 do
        local fn = table.remove(pending)
        if not reachable[fn] then
            reachable[fn] = true
            for callee in pairs(fn.calls) do pending[#pending + 1] = callee end
        end
    end
    for _, fn in ipairs(analysis.functions) do
        if not reachable[fn] then result[#result + 1] = { fn.name_position, "function '" .. fn.name .. "' is never called" } end
    end
    table.sort(result, function(a, b) return position_less(a[1], b[1]) end)
    return result, reachable
end
local function is_recursive(fn)
    local pending, seen = {}, {}
    for callee in pairs(fn.calls) do pending[#pending + 1] = callee end
    while #pending > 0 do
        local current = table.remove(pending)
        if current == fn then return true end
        if not seen[current] then
            seen[current] = true
            for callee in pairs(current.calls) do pending[#pending + 1] = callee end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local F = {}
F.__index = F
local function literal(node) return node.kind == "integer" or node.kind == "boolean" end
local function literal_value(node, kind, value) return node.kind == kind and node.value == value end
local function as_integer(node)
    if node.kind == "boolean" then return node.value and 1 or 0 end
    return node.value
end
function F:new_literal(node, value)
    self.count = self.count + 1
    local kind = node.type == "bool" and "boolean" or "integer"
    if kind == "boolean" then value = value ~= 0 and value ~= false end
    return Parser.node(kind, node.position, { value = value, type = node.type })
end
function F:identity(expression) self.count = self.count + 1; return expression end
function F:expression(node)
    if node.kind == "unary" then
        node.operand = self:expression(node.operand)
        if literal(node.operand) then
            local value = VM.calculate(node.operator == "-" and "NEG" or "NOT", as_integer(node.operand))
            if value ~= nil then return self:new_literal(node, value) end
        end
    elseif node.kind == "binary" then
        node.left, node.right = self:expression(node.left), self:expression(node.right)
        local left, right, op = node.left, node.right, node.operator
        if literal(left) and literal(right) then
            local a, b, value = as_integer(left), as_integer(right)
            if op == "&&" then value = a ~= 0 and b ~= 0
            elseif op == "||" then value = a ~= 0 or b ~= 0
            else value = VM.calculate(G.binary[op], a, b) end
            if value ~= nil then return self:new_literal(node, value) end
        end
        if op == "&&" and literal_value(left, "boolean", false) then return self:new_literal(node, false) end
        if op == "||" and literal_value(left, "boolean", true) then return self:new_literal(node, true) end
        if (op == "&&" and literal_value(left, "boolean", true))
            or (op == "||" and literal_value(left, "boolean", false))
            or (op == "+" and literal_value(left, "integer", 0))
            or (op == "*" and literal_value(left, "integer", 1)) then return self:identity(right) end
        if ((op == "+" or op == "-") and literal_value(right, "integer", 0))
            or ((op == "*" or op == "/") and literal_value(right, "integer", 1))
            or (op == "&&" and literal_value(right, "boolean", true))
            or (op == "||" and literal_value(right, "boolean", false)) then return self:identity(left) end
    elseif node.kind == "array" then node.index = self:expression(node.index)
    elseif node.kind == "call" then
        for i, argument in ipairs(node.arguments) do node.arguments[i] = self:expression(argument) end
    end
    return node
end
function F:statement(node)
    local kind = node.kind
    if kind == "declaration" then
        if node.initializer then node.initializer = self:expression(node.initializer) end
    elseif kind == "assignment" then
        if node.index then node.index = self:expression(node.index) end
        node.value = self:expression(node.value)
    elseif kind == "call_statement" then node.expression = self:expression(node.expression)
    elseif kind == "print" then
        for i, argument in ipairs(node.arguments) do node.arguments[i] = self:expression(argument) end
    elseif kind == "return" then
        if node.value then node.value = self:expression(node.value) end
    elseif kind == "block" then
        for i, child in ipairs(node.statements) do node.statements[i] = self:statement(child) end
    elseif kind == "if" then
        node.condition = self:expression(node.condition)
        if node.condition.kind == "boolean" then
            local selected = node.condition.value and node.consequent or node.otherwise
            local replacement = selected and self:statement(selected) or Parser.node("empty", node.position)
            self.count = self.count + 1
            return replacement
        end
        node.consequent = self:statement(node.consequent)
        if node.otherwise then node.otherwise = self:statement(node.otherwise) end
    elseif kind == "while" then
        node.condition = self:expression(node.condition)
        if literal_value(node.condition, "boolean", false) then
            self.count = self.count + 1
            return Parser.node("empty", node.position)
        end
        node.body = self:statement(node.body)
    elseif kind == "for" then
        if node.initial then node.initial = self:statement(node.initial) end
        if node.condition then node.condition = self:expression(node.condition) end
        if node.update then node.update = self:statement(node.update) end
        node.body = self:statement(node.body)
    end
    return node
end
local function jumps_on(op, value) return (value == 0) == (op == "JUMPF") end
local function delete_instruction(code, p)
    table.remove(code, p)
    for _, instruction in ipairs(code) do
        if G.jumps[instruction.op] and instruction.args[1] > p then instruction.args[1] = instruction.args[1] - 1 end
    end
end
local function rewrite(code, i, targets)
    local first, second = code[i], code[i + 1]
    local free = second and not targets[i + 1]
    if free and first.op == "PUSH" and G.conditional[second.op] then
        if jumps_on(second.op, first.args[1]) then
            code[i] = G.instruction("JUMP", { second.args[1] }, second.position)
            delete_instruction(code, i + 1)
        else delete_instruction(code, i + 1); delete_instruction(code, i) end
        return 1
    elseif free and G.negated[first.op] and second.op == "NOT" then
        code[i] = G.instruction(G.negated[first.op], {}, first.position)
        delete_instruction(code, i + 1)
        return 2
    elseif free and first.op == "NOT" and G.conditional[second.op] then
        code[i] = G.instruction(G.inverse[second.op], { second.args[1] }, second.position)
        delete_instruction(code, i + 1)
        return 3
    elseif free and G.conditional[first.op] and first.args[1] == i + 2 and second.op == "JUMP" then
        code[i] = G.instruction(G.inverse[first.op], { second.args[1] }, first.position)
        delete_instruction(code, i + 1)
        return 4
    end
    if G.jumps[first.op] then
        local target, new_target = first.args[1], false
        if target <= #code then
            local destination, following = code[target], code[target + 1]
            if destination.op == "JUMP" then new_target = destination.args[1]
            elseif destination.op == "PUSH" and following and G.conditional[following.op] then
                new_target = jumps_on(following.op, destination.args[1]) and following.args[1] or target + 2
            end
            if new_target and new_target ~= target then first.args[1] = new_target; return 5 end
        end
        if target == i + 1 then
            if first.op == "JUMP" then delete_instruction(code, i) else code[i] = G.instruction("POP", {}, first.position) end
            return 6
        end
    end
    if free and G.transfers[first.op] then delete_instruction(code, i + 1); return 7 end
    return 0
end
local function optimize(original)
    local code, counts = {}, { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 }
    for i, instruction in ipairs(original) do code[i] = G.instruction(instruction.op, { table.unpack(instruction.args) }, instruction.position) end
    while true do
        local targets, applied = {}, false
        for _, instruction in ipairs(code) do if G.jumps[instruction.op] then targets[instruction.args[1]] = true end end
        for i = 1, #code do
            local rule = rewrite(code, i, targets)
            if rule > 0 then counts[rule], applied = counts[rule] + 1, true; break end
        end
        if not applied then return code, counts end
    end
end
local function successors(code, i)
    local instruction, result = code[i], {}
    if not G.transfers[instruction.op] and i < #code then result[1] = i + 1 end
    if G.jumps[instruction.op] then
        local target = instruction.args[1]
        if target <= #code and result[1] ~= target then result[#result + 1] = target end
    end
    return result
end
local pushing = { PUSH = true, LOADG = true, LOADL = true, READ = true }
local popping = { POP = true, STOREG = true, STOREL = true, JUMPF = true, JUMPT = true, RETV = true,
    ADD = true, SUB = true, MUL = true, DIV = true, MOD = true, LT = true, LE = true, GT = true, GE = true, EQ = true, NE = true }
local function stack_effect(instruction, functions)
    local op, args = instruction.op, instruction.args
    if pushing[op] then return 1 elseif popping[op] then return -1 elseif op == "STOREA" then return -2
    elseif op == "CALL" then return -args[2] + (functions[args[1]].type ~= "void" and 1 or 0)
    elseif op == "PRINT" then return -args[1] end
    return 0
end
local function analyze_flow(unit, functions)
    local code, leaders = unit.after, { [1] = true }
    for i, instruction in ipairs(code) do
        if G.jumps[instruction.op] and instruction.args[1] <= #code then leaders[instruction.args[1]] = true end
        if (G.jumps[instruction.op] or G.transfers[instruction.op]) and i < #code then leaders[i + 1] = true end
    end
    local starts, block_numbers = {}, {}
    for leader in pairs(leaders) do starts[#starts + 1] = leader end
    table.sort(starts)
    for i, start in ipairs(starts) do block_numbers[start] = i - 1 end
    unit.blocks = {}
    for i, start in ipairs(starts) do
        local ending = starts[i + 1] and starts[i + 1] - 1 or #code
        local following = {}
        for _, target in ipairs(successors(code, ending)) do following[#following + 1] = block_numbers[target] end
        unit.blocks[i] = { start, ending, following }
    end
    local depths, pending, maximum = { [1] = 0 }, { 1 }, 0
    while #pending > 0 do
        local i = table.remove(pending)
        local after = depths[i] + stack_effect(code[i], functions)
        maximum = math.max(maximum, after)
        for _, target in ipairs(successors(code, i)) do
            if depths[target] == nil then depths[target], pending[#pending + 1] = after, target end
        end
    end
    unit.depth = maximum
end
local function link_units(units, version)
    local addresses, starts, offset = {}, {}, 0
    for _, unit in ipairs(units) do
        addresses[unit.name], starts[offset], unit[version .. "_start"] = offset, unit.name, offset
        offset = offset + #unit[version]
    end
    local code, owners = {}, {}
    for _, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local start = addresses[unit.name]
        for _, instruction in ipairs(unit[version]) do
            local args = { table.unpack(instruction.args) }
            if G.jumps[instruction.op] then args[1] = start + args[1] - 1
            elseif instruction.op == "CALL" then args[1] = addresses[args[1]] end
            code[#code + 1], owners[#owners + 1] = G.instruction(instruction.op, args, instruction.position), unit.name
        end
    end
    return code, owners, starts
end
local function compile(program)
    local tokens = lexer.tokenize(program.lines)
    local declarations = Parser.new(tokens):parse()
    local analysis = Analyzer.new(declarations, tokens[#tokens].position):analyze()
    program.analysis = analysis
    local reachable
    program.warnings, reachable = warnings(analysis)
    local globals, functions, function_table = {}, {}, {}
    for _, declaration in ipairs(declarations) do if declaration.kind == "global" then globals[#globals + 1] = declaration end end
    for _, fn in ipairs(analysis.functions) do
        if reachable[fn] then functions[#functions + 1], function_table[fn.name] = fn, fn end
    end
    local folder = setmetatable({ count = 0 }, F)
    for _, variable in ipairs(globals) do if variable.initializer then variable.initializer = folder:expression(variable.initializer) end end
    for _, fn in ipairs(functions) do fn.body = folder:statement(fn.body) end
    program.globals, program.folds = globals, folder.count
    program.units, program.global_size = G.generate(globals, functions, analysis.globals.main)
    program.peephole = { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 }
    for _, unit in ipairs(program.units) do
        local counts
        unit.after, counts = optimize(unit.before)
        for i, count in ipairs(counts) do program.peephole[i] = program.peephole[i] + count end
        analyze_flow(unit, function_table)
        unit.recursive = unit.fn and is_recursive(unit.fn)
    end
    local before_owners, before_starts, after_starts
    program.before, before_owners, before_starts = link_units(program.units, "before")
    program.after, program.owners, after_starts = link_units(program.units, "after")
    program.execution = VM.new(program.after, program.owners, after_starts, program.global_size, program.inputs):run()
    program.comparison = VM.new(program.before, before_owners, before_starts, program.global_size, program.inputs):run()
end
local function spelling(instruction)

        lines[#lines + 1] = "status: compile error"

    if not execution.error then lines[#lines + 1] = "status: ok"; return lines end
    local instruction = program.after[execution.error_pc + 1]
    lines[#lines + 1] = "runtime error " .. position_text(instruction.position) .. ": " .. execution.error .. " in " .. program.owners[execution.error_pc + 1]
    append(lines, position_display(program, instruction.position))
    local callers = #execution.frames - 1
    for i = #execution.frames, math.max(2, #execution.frames - 4), -1 do
        local address = execution.frames[i].return_address - 1
        lines[#lines + 1] = "  called from " .. program.owners[address + 1] .. " at " .. position_text(program.after[address + 1].position)
    end

    table.sort(entries, function(a, b) return a[2] > b[2] or (a[2] == b[2] and a[1] < b[1]) end)
    return entries
end

    append(lines, { "executed: " .. execution.executed, "executed before peephole: " .. comparison.executed,
        "behaviour: " .. (same and "same" or "different"), "max call depth: " .. execution.max_depth,

    end

    for _, entry in ipairs(ordered_counts(opcodes)) do if entry[2] > 0 then lines[#lines + 1] = "  " .. entry[1] .. " " .. entry[2] end end

    for _, unit in ipairs(program.units) do if unit.fn then names[#names + 1] = unit.name end end
    table.sort(names, function(a, b) return functions[a] > functions[b] or (functions[a] == functions[b] and a < b) end)
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("  %s calls=%d executed=%d", name, execution.calls[name] or 0, functions[name])
    end

    for caller, callees in pairs(execution.pairs) do

    end
    table.sort(pairs_list, function(a, b)
        if a[3] ~= b[3] then return a[3] > b[3] end
        if a[1] ~= b[1] then return a[1] < b[1] end
        return a[2] < b[2]
    end)
    for _, entry in ipairs(pairs_list) do lines[#lines + 1] = "  " .. entry[1] .. " -> " .. entry[2] .. " " .. entry[3] end

    end
    lines[#lines + 1] = "coverage: " .. executed_lines .. " of " .. line_count .. " lines"
    table.sort(unexecuted)
    local not_executed = {}
    for _, line in ipairs(unexecuted) do not_executed[#not_executed + 1] = tostring(line) end
    lines[#lines + 1] = "not executed: " .. (#not_executed > 0 and table.concat(not_executed, " ") or "none")
    lines[#lines + 1] = "hot spots:"

    local entries = ordered_counts(hotspots)
    for i = 1, math.min(5, #entries) do

end
local function summary(programs)

            rows[#rows + 1] = { program.name, program.error.kind .. " error", "-", "-", "-" }

        "runtime errors: " .. runtime_errors, "folds: " .. folds, "peephole: " .. sum(peephole) }
    for i, rule in ipairs(rules) do lines[#lines + 1] = "  " .. rule .. " " .. peephole[i] end

    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do

    end
    return lines
end

for text in io.lines("input/program.src") do

        if not call_statement and referent.type == "void" then self:fail(node.position, "void function '" .. node.name .. "' used as a value") end
        result = referent.type
    elseif kind == "unary" then
        result = self:expression(node.operand)
        local required = node.operator == "-" and "int" or "bool"
        if result ~= required then self:fail(node.position, "operator '" .. node.operator .. "' requires " .. required .. " operand") end
    else
        local left = self:expression(node.left)
        local right = self:expression(node.right)
        local operator = node.operator
        if arithmetic[operator] or relational[operator] then
            if left ~= "int" or right ~= "int" then self:fail(node.position, "operator '" .. operator .. "' requires int operands") end
            result = arithmetic[operator] and "int" or "bool"
        elseif operator == "==" or operator == "!=" then
            if left ~= right then self:fail(node.position, "operator '" .. operator .. "' requires operands of the same type") end
            result = "bool"
        else
            if left ~= "bool" or right ~= "bool" then self:fail(node.position, "operator '" .. operator .. "' requires bool operands") end
            result = "bool"
        end
    end
    node.type = result
    return result
end
function A:constant_initializer(node)
    local first
    local function visit(current)
        local kind = current.kind
        if kind == "variable" or kind == "array" or kind == "call" or kind == "read" then
            local p = current.position
            if not first or p[1] < first[1] or (p[1] == first[1] and p[2] < first[2]) then first = p end
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(Parser.expression_children(current)) do visit(child) end
    end
    visit(node)
    if first then self:fail(first, "global initializer must be constant") end
    return self:expression(node)
end
function A:statement(node, loop_depth)
    loop_depth = loop_depth or 0
    local kind = node.kind
    if kind == "declaration" then
        local scope = self.scopes[#self.scopes]
        if node.type == "void" then self:fail(node.name_position, "variable '" .. node.name .. "' cannot have type void") end
        if scope[node.name] then self:fail(node.name_position, "redeclaration of '" .. node.name .. "'") end
        if node.initializer and self:expression(node.initializer) ~= node.type then
            self:fail(node.name_position, "type mismatch in initialization of '" .. node.name .. "'")
        end
        self:prepare(node)
        scope[node.name] = node
    elseif kind == "assignment" then
        node.referent = self:variable(node.name, node.position, node.index ~= nil, false)
        if node.index and self:expression(node.index) ~= "int" then self:fail(node.position, "index of '" .. node.name .. "' must be int") end
        if self:expression(node.value) ~= node.referent.type then self:fail(node.position, "type mismatch in assignment to '" .. node.name .. "'") end
    elseif kind == "call_statement" then self:expression(node.expression, true)
    elseif kind == "if" or kind == "while" then
        if self:expression(node.condition) ~= "bool" then self:fail(node.position, "condition of '" .. kind .. "' must be bool") end
        if kind == "if" then
            self:statement(node.consequent, loop_depth)
            if node.otherwise then self:statement(node.otherwise, loop_depth) end
        else self:statement(node.body, loop_depth + 1) end
    elseif kind == "for" then
        self.scopes[#self.scopes + 1] = {}
        if node.initial then self:statement(node.initial, loop_depth) end
        if node.condition and self:expression(node.condition) ~= "bool" then self:fail(node.position, "condition of 'for' must be bool") end
        if node.update then self:statement(node.update, loop_depth) end
        self:statement(node.body, loop_depth + 1)
        table.remove(self.scopes)
    elseif kind == "break" or kind == "continue" then
        if loop_depth == 0 then self:fail(node.position, "'" .. kind .. "' outside loop") end
    elseif kind == "return" then
        local fn = self.current_function
        if fn.type == "void" and node.value then self:fail(node.position, "function '" .. fn.name .. "' must not return a value") end
        if fn.type ~= "void" then
            if not node.value then self:fail(node.position, "function '" .. fn.name .. "' must return a value") end
            if self:expression(node.value) ~= fn.type then self:fail(node.position, "return value of '" .. fn.name .. "' must be " .. fn.type) end
        end
    elseif kind == "print" then
        for k, argument in ipairs(node.arguments) do
            if self:expression(argument) ~= "int" then self:fail(node.position, "argument " .. k .. " of 'print' must be int") end
        end
    elseif kind == "block" then
        self.scopes[#self.scopes + 1] = {}
        for _, child in ipairs(node.statements) do self:statement(child, loop_depth) end
        table.remove(self.scopes)
    end
end
function A:analyze()
    for _, node in ipairs(self.declarations) do
        if node.kind == "global" then
            if node.size ~= nil then
                if node.type ~= "int" then self:fail(node.name_position, "array '" .. node.name .. "' must have element type int") end
                if node.size == 0 then self:fail(node.size_position, "array '" .. node.name .. "' must have a positive size") end
            elseif node.type == "void" then self:fail(node.name_position, "variable '" .. node.name .. "' cannot have type void") end
        end
        if self.globals[node.name] then self:fail(node.name_position, "redeclaration of '" .. node.name .. "'") end
        if node.kind == "global" then
            if node.initializer and self:constant_initializer(node.initializer) ~= node.type then
                self:fail(node.name_position, "type mismatch in initialization of '" .. node.name .. "'")
            end
        else
            local names = {}
            for _, parameter in ipairs(node.parameters) do
                if parameter.type == "void" then self:fail(parameter.name_position, "parameter '" .. parameter.name .. "' cannot have type void") end
                if names[parameter.name] then self:fail(parameter.name_position, "redeclaration of '" .. parameter.name .. "'") end
                names[parameter.name] = true
                self:prepare(parameter)
            end
        end
        self:prepare(node)
        self.globals[node.name] = node
    end
    local main = self.globals.main
    if not main or main.kind ~= "function" then self:fail(self.end_position, "no main function") end
    if main.type ~= "void" or #main.parameters > 0 then self:fail(main.name_position, "main must be declared as 'void main()'") end
    for _, fn in ipairs(self.functions) do
        self.current_function, self.scopes = fn, { {} }
        for _, parameter in ipairs(fn.parameters) do self.scopes[1][parameter.name] = parameter end
        for _, statement in ipairs(fn.body.statements) do self:statement(statement) end
        if fn.type ~= "void" and A.can_complete(fn.body) then self:fail(fn.name_position, "missing return in function '" .. fn.name .. "'") end
    end
    return self
end
return A

local V = {}
V.__index = V
V.binary = { ADD = true, SUB = true, MUL = true, DIV = true, MOD = true, LT = true,
    LE = true, GT = true, GE = true, EQ = true, NE = true }
local function trunc_div(a, b)
    local quotient = math.abs(a) // math.abs(b)
    return (a < 0) ~= (b < 0) and -quotient or quotient
end
function V.calculate(op, a, b)
    if (op == "DIV" or op == "MOD") and b == 0 then return nil, "division by zero" end
    local value
    if op == "ADD" then value = a + b
    elseif op == "SUB" then value = a - b
    elseif op == "MUL" then value = a * b
    elseif op == "DIV" then value = trunc_div(a, b)
    elseif op == "MOD" then value = a - trunc_div(a, b) * b
    elseif op == "NEG" then value = -a
    elseif op == "NOT" then value = a == 0 and 1 or 0
    elseif op == "LT" then value = a < b and 1 or 0
    elseif op == "LE" then value = a <= b and 1 or 0
    elseif op == "GT" then value = a > b and 1 or 0
    elseif op == "GE" then value = a >= b and 1 or 0
    elseif op == "EQ" then value = a == b and 1 or 0
    elseif op == "NE" then value = a ~= b and 1 or 0
    else error("unknown arithmetic instruction " .. op) end
    if value < -2147483648 or value > 2147483647 then return nil, "integer overflow" end
    return value
end
function V.new(code, owners, starts, global_size, inputs)
    local result = setmetatable({ code = code, owners = owners, starts = starts, inputs = inputs,
        globals = {}, stack = {}, frames = {}, read_position = 1, pc = 0, executed = 0,
        counts = {}, calls = {}, pairs = {}, max_stack = 0, max_depth = 0, output = {} }, V)
    for i = 1, global_size do result.globals[i] = 0 end
    for i = 1, #code do result.counts[i] = 0 end
    return result
end
function V:step()
    local instruction = self.code[self.pc + 1]
    local op, args, stack = instruction.op, instruction.args, self.stack
    local next_pc = self.pc + 1
    if op == "PUSH" then stack[#stack + 1] = args[1]
    elseif op == "POP" then table.remove(stack)
    elseif op == "LOADG" then stack[#stack + 1] = self.globals[args[1] + 1]
    elseif op == "STOREG" then self.globals[args[1] + 1] = table.remove(stack)
    elseif op == "LOADL" then stack[#stack + 1] = self.frames[#self.frames].locals[args[1] + 1]
    elseif op == "STOREL" then self.frames[#self.frames].locals[args[1] + 1] = table.remove(stack)
    elseif op == "LOADA" or op == "STOREA" then
        local value
        if op == "STOREA" then value = table.remove(stack) end
        local index = table.remove(stack)
        if index < 0 or index >= args[2] then return nil, string.format("index %d out of bounds for array of size %d", index, args[2]) end
        if op == "LOADA" then stack[#stack + 1] = self.globals[args[1] + index + 1]
        else self.globals[args[1] + index + 1] = value end
    elseif V.binary[op] then
        local b, a = table.remove(stack), table.remove(stack)
        local value, err = V.calculate(op, a, b)
        if err then return nil, err end
        stack[#stack + 1] = value
    elseif op == "NEG" or op == "NOT" then
        local value, err = V.calculate(op, table.remove(stack))
        if err then return nil, err end
        stack[#stack + 1] = value
    elseif op == "JUMP" then next_pc = args[1]
    elseif op == "JUMPF" or op == "JUMPT" then
        local value = table.remove(stack)
        if (value == 0) == (op == "JUMPF") then next_pc = args[1] end
    elseif op == "CALL" then
        if #self.frames == 100 then return nil, "call depth limit exceeded" end
        local values, count = {}, args[2]
        for i = count, 1, -1 do values[i] = table.remove(stack) end
        self.frames[#self.frames + 1] = { locals = values, return_address = next_pc }
        local callee, caller = self.starts[args[1]], self.owners[self.pc + 1]
        self.calls[callee] = (self.calls[callee] or 0) + 1
        if not self.pairs[caller] then self.pairs[caller] = {} end
        self.pairs[caller][callee] = (self.pairs[caller][callee] or 0) + 1
        next_pc = args[1]
    elseif op == "ENTER" then
        local area = self.frames[#self.frames].locals
        for i = #area + 1, args[1] do area[i] = 0 end
    elseif op == "RET" or op == "RETV" then next_pc = table.remove(self.frames).return_address
    elseif op == "READ" then
        if self.read_position > #self.inputs then return nil, "read past end of input" end
        stack[#stack + 1], self.read_position = self.inputs[self.read_position], self.read_position + 1
    elseif op == "PRINT" then
        local values = {}
        for i = args[1], 1, -1 do values[i] = tostring(table.remove(stack)) end
        self.output[#self.output + 1] = table.concat(values, " ")
    end
    self.max_stack, self.max_depth = math.max(self.max_stack, #stack), math.max(self.max_depth, #self.frames)
    self.pc = next_pc
    return op ~= "HALT"
end
function V:run()
    while true do
        if self.executed == 100000 then
            self.error, self.error_pc = "instruction limit exceeded", self.pc
            break
        end
        self.executed = self.executed + 1
        self.counts[self.pc + 1] = self.counts[self.pc + 1] + 1
        local more, err = self:step()
        if err then self.error, self.error_pc = err, self.pc; break end
        if not more then break end
    end
    return self
end
return V
